jobs.description_text: About Us Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real-world action. The company’s initial focus is stroke-related motor impairment, with expansion in cognitive decline and other neurological disorders, focusing on long-term solutions for the growing aging population. The Role We're looking for someone to join our People team onsite, five days a week, at our Alameda office. This is a great opportunity to work across a range of different areas, including recruiting, employer branding, vendor management, and day to day HR operations, while reporting directly to our COO. We're looking for someone who's highly organized, comfortable moving between different types of work in the same day, and excited to build a long-term career in HR. jobs.title: Chief of Staff (AI-Native)
jobs.description_text: About Us Embedding VC is an early-stage venture fund investing at the frontier of AI. Embedding Labs is our sister studio, where we incubate and build AI-native companies from scratch alongside founders. We're looking for a Chief of Staff who can move fluidly between both sides of the house: helping the fund run better and helping the studio build faster. The Role This is a hybrid operator role for someone who is comfortable being hands-on with AI tools, telling our story to the outside world, and keeping the internal machine running smoothly. You'll work directly with the founding team across investment, community, and company-building workstreams. We're not looking for a traditional "chief of staff" who just manages calendars and decks. We want someone AI-native: someone who reaches for AI tools by default to build, automate, and ship. What You'll Do • AI Development — Build and maintain internal tools and workflows using AI (Claude, agents, automations) to speed up how the fund and studio operate, from deal research to content generation to portfolio tracking. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be fluent in using AI-assisted coding and automation tools to ship real things. • GTM — Own parts of how we show up externally: social content, community events (like our Weekly Launch Hour), and outreach to strategic partners. jobs.title: AI Agent Tech Lead
jobs.description_text: About Lingopal Lingopal builds real-time AI language technology, with a live translation product used in production today. We're now building our next product — an AI agent platform aimed at enterprises with heavy customer-support needs (hospitality, airlines, travel) and fast-scaling AI-agent companies. About the Role We're looking for a AI Agent Tech Lead to be an early, hands-on builder for our new AI agent product — and to grow into technical leadership as the team scales. You'll work directly with the founders, own core backend/full-stack systems, and move fast: we're testing with pilot customers in Q4 2026, and the direction will sharpen based on what we learn. Speed and adaptability matter more here than infrastructure depth or performance optimization — we need someone who ships. jobs.title: GTM Lead
jobs.description_text: About Lingopal Lingopal builds real-time AI language technology, with a live translation product used in production today. We're now building our next product — an AI agent platform. Our target customers are enterprises with heavy customer-support needs (hospitality, airlines, travel) and fast-scaling AI-agent companies (Series C/D). About the Role We're looking for a GTM Lead to build our go-to-market motion from scratch — the first dedicated GTM hire for our new product. This is a sales-focused, build-the-playbook role: you'll own the sales strategy, run early enterprise conversations, and figure out what works before we scale it. You'll partner directly with the founders and help validate the go-to-market as the product itself is still evolving. What You'll Do - Build the GTM playbook from zero — positioning, target accounts, outbound motion, sales process, pricing inputs. - Own enterprise sales end-to-end: prospecting, discovery, pilots, and closing. - Sell into two segments: enterprises with heavy customer-support needs (e.g. hospitality, airlines) and AI-agent companies (Series C/D). Reach and win buyers at the Chief AI Officer, COO, and CTO level. - Bring the market read back into product — your early conversations will help shape and validate direction. jobs.title: GTM Specialist
jobs.description_text: About Lingopal Lingopal builds real-time AI language technology, with a live translation product used in production today. We're now building our next product — an AI agent platform aimed at enterprises with heavy customer-support needs and fast-scaling AI-agent companies. About the Role We're looking for a junior GTM Specialist to support our go-to-market as we build a new product and motion. This is a great fit for someone with a technical background (CS) who doesn't want to be a software engineer — someone content- and growth-oriented, eager to learn the business side, and excited to be close to both the product and the customer. What You'll Do - Support the GTM Lead and founders across sales, growth, and content. - Create technical content that makes a complex AI product legible to buyers. - Run growth experiments, support outbound, and help build the top of the funnel. - Use your technical fluency to speak credibly with technical buyers (CTOs, AI teams) and to work closely with engineering. - Learn the GTM playbook from the ground up. What We're Looking For - Technical background (CS or similar) — you understand technical products — but you're not looking to be a software engineer. - Content- and growth-oriented, with strong writing and communication. - Eager to learn the business/GTM side fast; high energy and ownership. - Comfortable in an early-stage, fast, low-process environment.

jobs.title: Founding GTM Lead
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US GenMD is unlocking healthcare data at scale. Today, roughly 97% of healthcare data goes unused because of patient privacy concerns. We’ve found a way to unlock that data—safely and ethically—for AI labs, pharma companies, and researchers. We provide the core infrastructure that enables better drugs, faster clinical trials, and more powerful medical research—the kind of foundation that makes real breakthroughs, including curing diseases, possible. Our company was built out of years inside Stanford Medicine, working closely with world-class researchers and clinicians. We have access to tens of millions of patients, longitudinal health records, and clinical notes. GenMD is just coming out of stealth, already revenue-generating, well-funded, and backed by premier investors with years of runway. We’re intentionally small, move fast, and are focused on building something fundamental. THE PRODUCT We turn a health system's real patient data into privacy-preserving digital twins — synthetic records that keep the statistical structure of the original without exposing a single patient. Health systems monetize data they could never share; researchers, pharma, and AI labs get same-day access instead of waiting months on IRB and contracting. jobs.title: Provider Strategy Lead
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients. Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions. Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption: - Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world. - AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable. - Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity. Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster. If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine. All full-time roles are in person in New York. ABOUT T

jobs.title: People & Finance Lead
jobs.description_text: PEOPLE & FINANCE LEAD $80,000 - $140,000 + 0.02% - 0.12% Somerville, MA ABOUT GLIMPSE The last decade has been incredibly exciting for electric mobility. However, the electrification of the transportation industry has scaled while relying on an insufficient set of quality control tools. This has led to uncomfortably high rates of battery pack failure and multi-billion-dollar safety recalls. In our view, every headline of electric vehicles and e-bikes catching fire is a major impediment towards an all-electric future. After having spent a few years in the trenches of battery and electric vehicle factories at Tesla and Toyota, Glimpse’s cofounders set out to build a technology to enable battery quality at scale. In 2024, Glimpse launched the Glimpse Portal, the first scalable X-ray-powered quality management platform for battery cells. After quadrupling revenue in 2025, Glimpse is now expanding into new hardware industries that rely too heavily on an outdated X-ray scanning technology stack to control the quality of their parts.
